data.gender_notes: Linette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin linum meaning ‘linen, flax’. Linette embodies the gentle, nurturing light of a mother, representing purity and refinement. This name was popularized in medieval Europe, and its lyrical, melodic sound continues to enchant and inspire. The name Linette carries the meaning “Light, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Linette usually hope their child will grow to embody light, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and hope in the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Linette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Luminous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Linette total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

This name is reminiscent of refinement, elegance, and connection to the earth through the traditional use of linen.
data.spiritual_significance: Linette is a name with a strong spiritual connection to the Christian faith, symbolizing gentle, nurturing, and pure love. As a nod to its Latin origins, Linette represents the maternal divine, offering comfort, tenderness, and protection. It also represents desirable girl qualities such as grace, charm, and a nurturing spirit. This name invites a sense of union with the divine feminine and encourages a focus on spiritual growth and self-love.
